tasks.short: Assess illness or injury effects on patients' lives

steps.what: Explore illness or injury effects on health, function, development, nutrition, sleep and relationships
Assess impacts on quality of life and family, social and educational relationships and record concerns
outputs: documented impact assessment and support concerns

tasks.design: Retain contextual assessment with the nurse and capture findings in the existing clinical record {OTHER}. No questionnaire score or generated life-impact conclusion replaces the patient's account and nursing judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effects differ between patients and may not be explicit in the medical record.
tasks.enabler_now: Current records support the conversation without a new assessment model.
tasks.still_hard: Understand the patient's priorities and distinguish related effects from unsupported assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Ask sensitive questions and relate observations to the person's circumstances.
tasks.altitude: A grounded understanding of how illness affects this person.

reach.task: Clarify support needs raised by the impact assessment
reach.learn: Which effects matter most to the patient

evidence.claim: Documentation drafting does not establish reduced contextual life-impact assessment work.

assumptions: The patient produces their account during s1 and care staff provide existing clinical context; all elicitation and verification time remains.
The nurse produces and captures the impact assessment in s2; no free structured functional or quality-of-life feed is assumed.
Family input is obtained only through existing appropriate sharing arrangements; clarification remains within retained time.
No new assessment tool or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Existing impact assessment approach and support options
research_questions: Which impacts are not apparent until the nurse asks follow-up questions?

already_counted.description: Elicitation, assessment and findings capture remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new assessment system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. Patient conversation and impact judgement retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the protocol question, select authoritative source passages and capture local practice concerns
outputs: verified source packet and local concerns

steps.what: Draft proposed practice protocol changes with source references and unresolved questions
inputs: verified source packet and local concerns
outputs: draft protocol contribution with passage references

loop.purpose: Draft a source-grounded contribution for protocol development, without deciding clinical policy.
loop.input: Nurse-selected authoritative passages, current protocol and captured local concerns.
loop.output: Proposed wording and a change table with exact source passages and unresolved conflicts.
loop.check: The nurse verifies that every proposed instruction preserves the source conditions, exclusions, strength of recommendation and uncertainty, and checks omissions against the packet.
loop.stop: One draft and at most one correction pass; unsupported instructions, contradictory evidence or failed semantic review return the section to manual drafting.
loop.why_not_simpler: Version comparison is deterministic, but proposing clear wording from source passages and local concerns requires bounded language interpretation.

steps.what: Verify proposed protocol wording and contribute reviewed changes and concerns to the protocol group
inputs: draft protocol contribution with passage references
verified source packet and local concerns

tasks.design: Use a bounded drafting step over the nurse's verified source packet in an approved document environment {DOCS}. The nurse checks the clinical meaning and contributes the final reviewed proposal to the protocol group; formal adoption and implementation remain with existing governance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drafting change wording and its source rationale repeats prose work after evidence review.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded language model can propose cited wording from a supplied packet, but its accuracy and net benefit must be validated locally.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting evidence, preserve exceptions and assess practical feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether wording changes the intended clinical action and bring experience to the group.
tasks.altitude: Less prose preparation with retained evidence appraisal and protocol discussion.

reach.task: Review proposed wording and unresolved evidence questions
reach.learn: Which changes require further evidence or implementation work

evidence.claim: Source-grounded protocol contribution drafting is an E1 proposal; clinical scribe cases do not establish protocol development savings.

assumptions: Publishers and clinical governance produce existing full sources and current protocol; the nurse selects and verifies passages and captures local concerns in s1, with all selection time retained.
No free structured evidence table or automatically appraised recommendation is assumed.
The model uses only the selected packet and never invents source passages; missing support remains an explicit question.
Native document comparison and tracked changes come first; use the model only for bounded wording proposals.
s3 approves only the nurse's contribution; separate group review, final adoption and implementation remain unchanged outside this contribution baseline.
No patient-identifiable data are required in the drafting packet.
unknowns: Approved drafting environment and current prose preparation share
research_questions: Do bounded drafts reduce total contribution time after checking exceptions, omissions and source meaning?

already_counted.description: Source selection and final review and protocol discussion remain fully counted.
Draft review and manual sections remain counted.

incremental.description: Nurse participates in source-fidelity audits and checks drafting updates.
Documentation owner maintains drafting structure and evaluates model changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected protocol contribution, proposed instructions, source passages, exclusions and unresolved questions; edits or source changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+15+40=85; gross 15 less 3 focal audits gives net 12. High requires substantial supported prose preparation; low covers manual fallback or semantic checking consuming gains. Group adoption time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the patient's healthcare activities, instructions, appointments and practical organisation barriers
outputs: verified activity needs and practical barriers

steps.what: Assist patients in organising healthcare activities and confirm contacts, sequence and next steps
inputs: verified activity needs and practical barriers
outputs: understood patient activity plan and unresolved coordination concerns

tasks.design: Retain patient-specific organisation support using current clinical information {OTHER} and an understandable activity list {DOCS}. No clean cross-provider schedule or automated care navigation is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activities and practical barriers must be reconciled with what the patient understands and can do.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instructions and appointment information support assistance without a new agent.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting instructions, inaccessible contacts and barriers to following the plan.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise why an apparently clear activity list is not workable for this patient.
tasks.altitude: Make healthcare activities understandable and practicable.

reach.task: Resolve activities or contacts needing further coordination
reach.learn: Which practical barriers prevent the patient following the plan

evidence.claim: Clinical record tools do not establish a complete cross-provider activity feed or reduced patient organisation support time.

assumptions: Clinicians produce instructions and facility schedulers produce appointment information in existing processes; the nurse locates and clarifies them in s1.
The nurse elicits barriers in s1 and captures the activity list and checks understanding in s2; all capture time remains.
No free structured address, appointment status or complete care pathway is assumed; uncertainty is resolved through retained coordination.
New bookings and downstream coordinator actions remain separate tasks; no new system or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Completeness of existing activity information and patient support needs
research_questions: Which activity details require additional contact before the patient can use the plan?

already_counted.description: Information clarification and patient organisation support remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new care navigation system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work yield zero saving. No patient conversation or unsupported schedule assembly reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe within authority and modify after observing response

steps.what: Assess medication needs and prescribe only within verified professional authority
outputs: authorised prescription or escalated prescribing recommendation

steps.what: Observe patients' reactions and reassess medication effectiveness and concerns
inputs: authorised prescription or escalated prescribing recommendation

steps.what: Modify prescriptions within authority or refer changes and record the decision and follow-up
outputs: authorised medication change or escalated recommendation

tasks.design: Retain prescribing and response-based changes with an appropriately authorised practitioner, using existing clinical records {OTHER}. Where the nurse lacks prescribing authority the output is an escalated recommendation; no model prescribes or modifies treatment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Medication decisions require patient context, observed response and explicit professional authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing medication surveillance supports current work but does not replace prescribing judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Interpret response and adverse concerns without attributing every change to the medication.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the patient and take responsibility for treatment judgement within scope.

reach.task: Review proposed medication changes beyond nursing authority
reach.learn: Which response observations are needed for a decision

evidence.claim: G-Standaard supports medication checks rather than independent prescribing or interpretation of patient response.

assumptions: Actual prescribing authority must be verified; this occupational statement does not confer it.
The nurse produces assessment in s1, observations in s2 and the permitted decision record in s3, with all acquisition and capture time retained.
Administering staff produce actual administration records in existing care; an order alone is not treated as administration.
Current medication checks are already in the baseline; no new response feed, automatic dose change or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Actual prescribing scope and current medication workflow
research_questions: Which medication changes can this worker authorise and which require another prescriber?

already_counted.description: Prescribing assessment, observation and change decisions remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new prescribing system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. Existing rules do not remove clinical observation or prescribing judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain clinical assessment and patient organisation support while reducing validated prose preparation for protocol contributions.
reach: Bring source-grounded proposals to protocol groups
Resolve patient coordination barriers with care teams
role.ambitious_version: An acute care nurse who contributes well-supported protocol ideas while preserving accountable patient and medication decisions.
